items.title: GitHub release: anthropics/claude-code v2.1.304
items.what_happened: ## What's changed - Added a transcript line when a plugin that runs first skips one of your mod's hooks, naming the event and the plugin - Added `decider: "person"` to a mod's `tool.check` answer: only the permission dialog or a host's callback can approve the ask, and it is refused with the mod's reason where nobody can be asked - Added `e.isReadOnly` to a mod's `tool.check` event, set when the tool call is read-onl

items.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
items.what_happened: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.
